verdict.rationale: Canva documents automation surfaces such as Autofill, Bulk create, the Apps SDK, the REST APIs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or rollback of those automations. Audit logs record user activities, which is an adjacent control and not automation version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
